THE EXAMINATION, EXPLAINED

Papers & components.

Choose the year you will sit the exam. The weighting applies to the qualification and route selected below.

EXAMINATION YEAR 2027ROUTE Two-paper route
Assessment components · 2010 · 2027 · Two-paper route
ComponentDurationMarksWeighting
PAPER 1Poetry and Prose1h 30m5050%
PAPER 2Drama1h 30m5050%

Both papers are compulsory and closed text. In 2027 this syllabus is available only in administrative zones 3, 4 and 5. Confirm your centre’s eligibility. The paper pattern and availability change in 2028.

Poetry and Prose — component 1+

One poetry response and one prose response; 25 marks each.

Drama — component 2+

Two responses on two drama texts; 25 marks each.

A PURPOSE FOR EVERY LESSON

What you’ll work on.

01

Poetry and prose

Explore the detail of language alongside character, theme and structure.

02

Drama in context

Consider voice, dialogue and the effects of a text written for performance.

03

A supported argument

Use precise references to make a coherent literary case.

WITH CENTURY ACADEMY

The support we offer.

Online English tuition with experienced teachers, available one-to-one or in a group. We discuss your syllabus, examination year and areas of difficulty before agreeing a lesson format.

Subject-focused teaching

Lessons centred on the reading, writing and analytical skills in this course.

One-to-one or groups

Choose individual attention or a shared learning setting, subject to availability.

A free first trial

Meet, discuss your goals and experience an online lesson before deciding.

Flexible arrangements

Discuss hourly or monthly tuition directly with the academy.

Lesson frequency, marking arrangements and set-text coverage are agreed with the teaching team. Coursework supervision and exam registration remain with your centre.
